快捷复制命令行统一在这复制, 防止出错
Git: 首次提交git add --allgit commit -m "BASE: Project Initialization"git tag v0.0.0



Git: dev / ux 分支每次提交git add --allgit commit -m "."



Git: 设置上游分支git branch --set-upstream-to=origin/dev

之后的每次 push
git push



Git: 合并分支git merge --squash dev -X theirs



Git: 推送所有分支git push --all origin



Git: 推送所有标签git push origin --tags



Git: 到某个 Commit ID 下 (游离)git checkout 572b52679d0a36c662fd8e011e2b8cb86cf215fd

title: Hello World
content:
Welcome to Hexo! This is your very first post. Check documentation for more info. If you get any problems when using Hexo, you can find the answer in troubleshooting or you can ask me on GitHub.
Quick StartCreate a new post$ hexo new "My New Post"

More info: Writing
Run server$ hexo server

More info: Server
Generate static files$ hexo generate

More info: Generating
Deploy to remote sites$ hexo deploy
